# Lighter Hours

> AI agents that take the busywork off your team. Lighter Hours designs, builds, and runs agentic automation for growing companies, with guardrails on every build: read-only data access, a second AI that checks every number, low-confidence hand-offs to a person, and a human yes before anything reaches a customer.

The work is proven in production: 60+ AI tools and workflows and 1,900+ hours of building and testing in production at a real company (anonymized). Highlights:

- Emails that chase their own answers: AI works out who has the missing answer, asks them directly in chat or email, and restarts the work the moment they reply (with a 20-minute sweep for late replies), checking every fact against its source before writing the reply.
- Agent mission control: one screen that shows every running AI helper, what it is working on, and whether it is waiting on a person. Reply, open the full session, or pin a reminder from the card. 36 replies went to waiting agents from it in its first two days.
- Ask your data in plain English: staff ask sales and operations questions and get tables and charts, through a view-only account. 36 of 36 test questions correct before release.
- A helpdesk that answers, then learns: hundreds of support tickets a month get an instant answer, 24% are fully solved by AI, and staff corrections become help-article fixes every week. A newer customer-facing version passed 29 of 29 safety tests and matched an experienced rep's decision on 47 of 47 past tickets.
- A second AI that checks every number: one AI builds reports and payout files, a separate read-only AI verifies them against a second source before they go out.

## Services

- AI Readiness Sprint (2 weeks): staff discovery, every idea scored on four tests, a tool plan, and a one-page AI use policy.
- First Pilot Build (30 to 60 days): one working AI workflow in your systems, with a baseline metric, blind tests, and a trained champion.
- Fractional AI Lead (monthly): new workflows each month, monitoring and fixes, and training for each new team.
